0022600096.text: The Orlando Magic (0-1, 10th in the East) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (1-0, 7th in the West) in the Magic's second game of the 2026-27 season, after losing their first game. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Magic won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 132-120 home win on April 8, 2026.
